title: Digital Islamic Banking Intelligence
thesis: Snowflake powers digital Islamic banking — Snowpipe Streaming ingests 2M transactions/month, ML detects fraud in real time, anomaly detection catches suspicious patterns, and Cortex Complete generates personalized Shariah-compliant offers

talking_points: Two million transactions per month — RM 890 million in monthly volume through our digital Islamic bank.
Straight-through processing at 99.2% — only 0.8% require manual intervention.
App rating at 4.2 stars — customer feedback drives product iteration.

transition.line: Let's look at what the fraud detection engine is catching.

talking_points: ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION scores every transaction — 127 flagged suspicious this month.
Account ACC-77201: 14 transactions in 8 minutes totaling RM 47,000 — velocity anomaly.
Snowpipe Streaming ingests transactions in sub-second — fraud scoring within 15 minutes.
tabs.call_out: 127 suspicious transactions — scored within 15 minutes of ingestion

transition.line: Fraud is handled. Let's see how AI personalizes the customer experience.

talking_points: ML.CLASSIFICATION segments 100,000 customers into 5 behavioral cohorts.
Cortex Complete generates Shariah-compliant product offers tailored to each segment.
Customer feedback analysis: 'Easy to use' leads positive themes, 'slow transfers' leads negative.

transition.line: Now let the CDO ask the system for strategic insights.

talking_points: Encik Hafiz asks: 'Which customer segment has the highest financing conversion rate?'
Cortex Analyst queries: Young Professionals segment at 8.4% conversion — 2x average.
Switch to advisory: 'What Shariah-compliant products should we offer this segment?' — generates strategy.
show: Switch to advisory mode for product strategy
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: banking analytics + product strategy advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake, real-time streaming to AI.

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, five AWS services in the dual-build.
Snowpipe Streaming replaces Kinesis for sub-second ingestion. ML functions replace external models.
BNM licensed 5 digital banks in 2022. This monitors 2M transactions, 100K accounts, 50 products.
tabs.call_out: One platform, real-time streaming, native ML — no external pipelines

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for digital Islamic banking.
